native_result.query: In the PCA on the forms of capital analyzed in hundred-year time slices, during the Younger Bronze Age (1100-500 BCE), how does the principal component value of PC1 in the beginning of the period at 1100 BCE differ from the subsequent time horizons between 1000 to 500 BCE?
native_result.HypoA: The beginning of the Younger Bronze Age (1100 BCE) is associated with negative values on the first principal component (PC1), while the majority of time horizons (1000-500 BCE) are characterized by positive values on PC1. This Principal component analysis (PCA) is on the forms of capital. The values of the individual elements of the forms of capital form the attributes.
native_result.HypoB: В PCA по формам капитала на столетних срезах PC1 в 1100 г. до н.э. достигает максимума серии (+4.51, ранг 1/39) и превышает среднее горизонтов 1000-500 гг. до н.э. (+1.43) на +3.08 (~5.3 SD) — резкий положительный выброс с обвалом до умеренного плато. По группировке study context выброс складывается из социального капитала (+1.54: медь/золото ZCU_AU +1.18, монументы +0.39), символического (+0.90: размер домов +0.46, кинжалы +0.43) и экономического (+0.86: почти целиком депоты/клады ZHort +0.81), при слегка отрицательном вкладе культурного капитала (−0.22, керамический декор). PC1 объясняет 30.3% дисперсии; доли |нагрузок|² по формам: cultural 27.1%, social 26.5%, economic 25.5%, symbolic 21.0%; знак PC1 фиксирован по положительной нагрузке ZCU_AU; устойчиво к leave-one-century-out (diff 3.07 [2.79, 3.30]).
native_result.WorkflowB: 1) capital.csv: 39 строк-столетий 4300-500 BCE, 12 Z-переменных, 0 пропусков. 2) Корреляционный PCA (полный SVD через numpy; sklearn недоступен в окружении), знак PC1 по ZCU_AU>0. 3) Скоры PC1 для YBA-строк; сравнение BCE=1100 vs 1000-500 (попарно и среднее, SD-нормировка, ранг в полной серии). 4) Нагрузки PC1 и доли |нагрузок|² по четырём формам капитала в группировке study context (symbolic: ZAxtSchwert/ZDolch/Zhausgr; social: ZCU_AU/Zamber/ZMonument; cultural: ZKeform/Zkeverz; economic: ZHort/ZSichel/ZBeil/ZMW). 5) Декомпозиция разницы 1100-vs-среднее(1000-500) по переменным и формам. 6) LOO-устойчивость (39 переоценок). sub_hypo.text: Capital PC1 reaches its series maximum at 1100 BCE (+4.51, rank 1/39), exceeding the mean for 1000–500 BCE (+1.43) by +3.08 (approximately 5.3 SD), indicating a sharp positive outlier followed by a collapse to a moderate plateau.
sub_hypo.context: capital.csv: 39 century-level observations from 4300–500 BCE, 12 Z variables and no missing values. Correlation PCA used full SVD, with PC1 oriented to give ZCU_AU a positive loading. Comparison concerns 1100 BCE versus 1000–500 BCE; pollen and time_series_data.csv were not used.
sub_hypo.relations: The PC1 score derived from the 12 capital variables peaks at 1100 BCE and exceeds the subsequent six-century mean by +3.08, approximately 5.3 SD.

sub_hypo.text: Under the study-context grouping, the 1100 BCE PC1 excess over the 1000–500 BCE mean is composed of positive social (+1.54), symbolic (+0.90) and economic (+0.86) capital contributions, partially offset by cultural capital (−0.22).
sub_hypo.context: Decomposition of the 1100 BCE minus mean 1000–500 BCE PC1 difference. Study-context grouping was corrected separately without recalculating PCA.
sub_hypo.relations: Social capital (ZCU_AU/Zamber/ZMonument) contributes +1.54, including copper/gold +1.18 and monument count +0.39. Symbolic capital (ZAxtSchwert/ZDolch/Zhausgr) contributes +0.90, including house size +0.46 and daggers +0.43. Economic capital (ZHort/ZSichel/ZBeil/ZMW) contributes +0.86, almost entirely depots/hoards (+0.81). Cultural capital (ZKeform/Zkeverz) contributes −0.22, attributed to pottery decoration.

sub_hypo.text: PC1 explains 30.3% of variance, with squared absolute loading shares of 27.1% cultural, 26.5% social, 25.5% economic and 21.0% symbolic capital.

sub_hypo.relations: The 1100 BCE versus mean 1000–500 BCE PC1 contrast remains positive under century omission, with reported difference 3.07 and bounds [2.79, 3.30].
